name: Crimson Moon's Semblance
passive: Grants a Bond of Life equal to of Max HP when a Charged Attack hits an opponent. This can be triggered up to once every. In addition, when the equipping character has a Bond of Life, they gain a DMG Bonus; if the value of the Bond of Life is greater than or equal to of Max HP, then gain an additional DMG.
